sentences.text: type=fact The UCB pre-payment directions say the rules in paragraph 261(1) and 261(2) apply irrespective of the source of funds used for pre-payment, either in part or in full, and without any minimum lock-in period.
type=fact The directions also say that where paragraph 261(1) or 261(2) does not apply, any pre-payment charges, if any, follow the UCB’s approved policy.
type=fact On the evidence provided, the source of funds is therefore not a factor that changes the pre-payment charge rule where paragraph 261(1) or 261(2) applies.

missing.slot: case-specific applicability of paragraph 261(1) or 261(2) to the loan
missing.searched: Reviewed the UCB pre-payment directions for source-of-funds treatment and found the source is irrelevant under paragraph 261(3), but the evidence does not establish whether this specific loan falls under paragraph 261(1) or 261(2).
